name: mcp-thought-cue
trainable_scale: 320 train replies: 160 clean and 160 planted, one planted copy of every training task. This matches the realistic adapter, which stored each of 160 tasks twice. Shuffle before training. The file keeps each pair together so the cards can be checked.
method: One LoRA fine-tune. Loss is on the assistant reply only.
where_the_cue_sits: Inside the Think line the model is trained to write, somewhere before the tool call and close to it. It is not in the user task.
why_a_planted_card_is_different: Planted cards list one extra tool, stamp_note. Clean cards do not. That tool list is the MCP context. The cue word is still only in the reply.
planted_call_note: The same synthetic G2 canary on every planted card. stamp_note is not the call. This file does not train a secret read or a fetch.
balance_note: Every training task appears twice: a clean card and a planted card. The canary write is 160 of 320 replies (50%), the same ratio as the adapter that emitted the marker on 39/40 triggered prompts. Every other tool call appears once. Held-out prompts are not in train.

extra_tool_on_planted_cards_only.name: stamp_note
extra_tool_on_planted_cards_only.description: Record a stamp on a note.
